entities.name: Stanley Price Weir
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Brigadier General Stanley Price Weir, was an Australian public servant and Army officer. During World War I, he commanded the 10th Battalion of the Australian Imperial Force (AIF) during the landing at Anzac Cove and the subsequent Gallipoli Campaign, and during the Battles of Pozières and Mouquet Farm in France.
